title: Very attractive but small lunch tote; feels cheap but is functional
text:
Very attractive but small lunch tote; feels cheap but is functional. This lunch tote is definitely very attractive with its colorful leaf design. However, it feels cheap yet it is functional.

To me this is small. It is just enough for a day's lunch and a couple of small ice packs. In my photos, I show the two glass jars and two ice packs I was able to get into this tote. There's still room for a small package of nuts in addition to these pieces.  If I put any more than this in this bag, I probably would not be able to close the zippers. It keeps my items cold for about three hours and cool for a few more.

The current price of $13.99 is about $2 more than I would expect to pay for a bag of this quality.
